name: Cyborg Robotics
summary:
Cyborg Robotics (Saiboge Robotics) develops embodied-intelligence systems for hazardous and physically demanding work. Its principal focus is on industries such as power generation, gas, petroleum, chemicals, coal and heavy manufacturing, where inspection and specialized operations can expose people to risk.

The company combines humanoid robotics with multimodal inspection equipment and learning-based task execution. Its business also covers general-purpose robotics, education and data collection, while specialized high-risk applications remain the central emphasis. The product and technology portfolio is intended to support both movement through industrial environments and physical work involving tools, equipment and heavy loads.
